assessment_summary.cou_name: Design decisions on fin pitch and TIM selection for EV inverter cold plate using Fluent 2023 R2

evidence_keywords: journaled runs only
Vendor benchmark suite passed (12/12 cases)
GitLab project INV-CHT-042
Fluent case/data CRCs logged
Checklist INV-QA-CHT rev C
Internal check versus analytic laminar pipe heat transfer at Re = 1200
0.3% error on Nusselt
0.1% on Δp
Vendor benchmark suite passed (12/12 cases)
Mesh refinement: 2.1M, 6.4M, and 18.7M cells
GCI on peak case temperature 1.8%
on Δp 0.6% (fine grid reference)
Alternate discretization (QUICK vs second-order upwind)
Residuals <1e-6
energy imbalance <0.2%
Ansys Fluent 2023 R2, double precision
Analysts certified to internal Fluent Level 2
pre-release checklist enforces wall-function y+ and energy balance checks
Peer handoff instructions included with run scripts
Steady RANS SST (no transition) with conjugate heat in solids
Roughness via equivalent sandgrain ks = 15 µm
Radiation neglected; rig heat loss audit
TIM modeled as solid layer, t = 0.2 mm, k = 3 W/m-K; later represented as contact resistance Rc = 1.1e-4 m2-K/W
Inputs: Inlet mass flow, 5% turbulence intensity; outlet static pressure
Temperature-dependent properties for PGW from ASHRAE tables
solid conductivities from vendor datasheets
coupon-informed prior (0.8–1.4e-4 m2-K/W)
same plate, same torque pattern on fasteners (preload 6.5 ±0.2 N·m)
12 TCs on case, 2 RTDs on coolant
Closed-loop setup with 30% PGW, cartridge heaters (500–1500 W)
flows 25, 40, 55 L/h; powers 700, 1100, 1500 W; Tin 25 and 35 C
Measurement uncertainty: T ±0.3 C (k=2), flow ±0.5%, Δp ±0.25 kPa
Mapping: Same plate, same torque pattern on fasteners (preload 6.5 ±0.2 N·m)
same glycol mix verified by refractometer
Across 18 points
mean absolute error on peak case temperature 1.3 C (max 3.2 C)
Δp error 4.0% mean (max 6.1%)
No trend in residuals vs. flow or power

expected_factors.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
evidence_keywords: predicts component case temperatures and plate pressure loss
targeted error bands ≤5 C on peak case temp and ≤7% on Δp
